STOMATOLOGIYA TALABALARI UCHUN
VIRTUAL PATIENT ENGLISH KURSI
Kurs modeli: talaba Virtual Patient bilan ingliz tilida muloqot qiladi, zarur holatda Smart Phrasebook (shpargalka) orqali yordam oladi va suhbat yakunida AI feedback asosida natijasini ko‘radi.
Vocabulary: mavzuga oid asosiy dental/medical so‘zlar.
Dialogda ishlatilgan fe’l zamonlarini juda sodda usulda tushunish
Talaba grammatik qoidani chuqur yodlamasdan, bemorning gapidan vaqt va ma’noni tez tushunsin.
Цель: студент должен быстро понимать время и смысл фразы пациента, не изучая сложную грамматику.
Doctor: Good morning. What brings you in today?
Patient: Good morning, Doctor. I’ve a toothache on the lower right side. The tooth has also become very sensitive.
Doctor: I see. Can you tell me about your tooth pain?
Maqsad: talaba bemorning tish og‘rig‘i va tish sezgirligi haqida ingliz tilida savollar bera olishi, og‘riqning turi, davomiyligi, triggerlari, joylashuvi va kuchini aniqlay olishi tushunishi lozim.
Doctor: Good morning! Welcome to our clinic. What brings you in for a full consultation today?

Patient: Good morning, Doctor. It’s been over a year since my last dental check-up. Recently, I’ve noticed some mild sensitivity to hot and cold food, and my gums bleed slightly when I brush. I wanted to get a comprehensive evaluation.

Doctor: You made the right decision coming in. A complete check-up is the best way to catch potential issues early. Before we begin the physical examination, do you have any pre-existing medical conditions, allergies, or are you currently taking any medications?
Patient: No major medical conditions or allergies, but I do take a daily multivitamin.
Vocabulary va Smart Phrasebook (To‘liq stomatologik konsultatsiya)

Maqsad: Talaba bemorni birinchi marta qabul qilish, bemorning umumiy va stomatologik anamnezini yig‘ish, og‘iz bo‘shlig‘i profilaktik ko‘rigi (oral cancer screening), milklarning yallig‘lanishi (gingival inflammation) hamda tish kariesining ilk bosqichlari haqida ingliz tilida erkin muloqot qila olishi lozim.
Doctor: Good afternoon. Please have a seat. What seems to be the problem?
Patient: Good afternoon, doctor. I’ve been having severe pain in my lower right tooth for the last few days. It has become difficult to eat and sleep.
Doctor: When did the pain first start, and has it been getting worse recently?
GRAMMAR — Present Perfect Continuous & Future Simple
Ma’nosi: o‘tmishda boshlangan va hozirgacha davom etayotgan holat yoki harakatni ifodalaydi.
Значение: действие или состояние началось в прошлом и продолжается до настоящего момента.
Maqsad: talaba tish sug‘urish jarayonida bemor bilan ingliz tilida suhbatni bosqichma-bosqich olib borishi, muolajani tushuntirishi va muolajadan keyingi tavsiyalarni bera olishi.
Har bir bosqich dialogdagi Doctor savollari va Patient javoblari asosida tuzilgan.
Mana, "Toothache — 3 Module" muloqotidagi jumlalar asosida grammatikaning to'liqroq izohi, o'zbekcha (lotin yozuvida) va ruscha tarjimalari bilan tayyorlangan qo'llanma:
1. Present Continuous va Present Perfect Continuous (Hozirgi davomli zamonlar)
Ayni vaqtda sodir bo'layotgan yoki yaqin o'tmishdan beri davom etib kelayotgan holatlarni ifodalaydi.
Misol: "I’m having an unbearable, throbbing pain in my upper left molar."
Doctor: Good afternoon. Come in and take a seat. What brings you to the clinic today?
Patient: Good afternoon, doctor. I’m having an unbearable, throbbing pain in my upper left molar. It’s been driving me crazy since last night.
Doctor: I’m sorry to hear that. Was the pain sudden, or had you been experiencing mild discomfort before it became this severe?
Maqsad: Talaba tish og'rig'i (pulpit) bilan kelgan bemor bilan muloqotni bosqichma-bosqich olib borishi va davolash rejasini tushuntirishi.
1. Opening — Bemorning asosiy shikoyatini va og'riq joyini aniqlash.
2. Onset & Duration — Og'riq qachon boshlangani va o'tmishdagi sezuvchanlikni aniqlash.
Eslatma: Ushbu lug'at 'Toothache' (B2) dialogida ishlatilgan barcha asosiy tibbiy iboralar va terminlarni o'z ichiga oladi.

first_paragraphs: Doctor: Good morning, Mr. Davis. Looking at your X-rays and recent examination, the root canal treatment on your lower right molar was successful, but the remaining natural tooth structure is heavily compromised. We need to discuss a permanent restorative solution.
Patient: Thank you, Doctor. I'm relieved the infection is gone, but I noticed a significant piece of the tooth broke off before the treatment. Is a standard composite filling no longer an option?

Doctor: Unfortunately, no. Because over 50% of the clinical crown is missing, a simple filling wouldn't withstand normal masticatory forces. I strongly recommend a full-coverage dental crown to restore both its function and structural integrity.
Patient: I see. What materials do you offer for crowns, and how do they differ in terms of durability and appearance?
Vocabulary va Smart Phrasebook (Tishni qayta tiklash va protezlash)

Maqsad: Talaba tishning strukturaviy zararlanishi, ildiz kanali davosidan so‘ng tishni tiklash (restavratsiya), tish tojlari (Zirconia, PFM), tish ko‘prigi (bridge) va dental implantatsiya (implant) xizmatlari bo‘yicha ingliz tilida erkin muloqot qila olishi, materiallar va muolajalarning afzallik hamda kamchiliklarini bemorga professional tarzda tushuntirib bera olishi lozim.
